subject: Prism Health - AZ1 production impact, emergency regional evacuate + one-time credit request
content:
From: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@prismhealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@prismhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production errors and latency spike from AZ1 - urgent

Priya,

We started seeing elevated 5xxs and token latency for our nightly billing batch at ~02:30 PT. The downstream jobs are timing out and retries are doubling our queue length. This is affecting all customers on our platform; impact window is ongoing. Can Redwood initiate a cross-region evacuate for our traffic? We need the DR shift and an ETA — business-critical. Also opening procurement loop re: credits for this outage (billing period impacted). Attaching brief traces.

Attachments: prism_incident_kvtrace.zip (attachment)

Alex Gomez
Head of Platform Ops, Prism Health
alex.gomez@prismhealth.com

---

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Jul 2028 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Prism Health - AZ1 production impact (urgent)

Team — forwarding Prism’s escalation. Key asks: (1) immediate regional evac from AZ1 to US-WEST3 for Prism’s tenant, (2) SLA credit estimate and ops confirmation on reroute timeline, (3) support contact for the customer bridge.

Quick notes:
- Current telemetry shows sustained 5xx rate ~3.5% and median token latency up 120% for Prism’s route.
- KV-cache eviction noise in AZ1 evident in the attached traces; likely local disk pressure + NPU hot-path contention.

Can SREs confirm whether we can apply the live routing override now and estimate failover duration (expected 9–12 minutes to drain with graceful session handoff)? Marissa — we’ll need an exec note if we exceed the usual emergency credit threshold.

Priya
Account Exec — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Jul 2028 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Prism Health - AZ1 production impact (urgent)

Acknowledged. Priya — I’m on the customer bridge. Drafting a concise comms template for the bridge and external follow-up.

Jonas / Dylan — can we get ops to: 1) authorize an immediate regional steer for prism-health-prod route only, 2) reserve emergency burst capacity in us-west3 (we may need to spin up two extra nodes with higher GPU cadence), 3) confirm if we should temporarily disable aggressive batching for Prism to reduce tail latency. If we cannot guarantee <200ms median in us-west3, propose soft-fallback (route 20% traffic first).

Also: Prism is asking for a one-off credit. Typical emergency credit cap per account is $15k without exec approval; Alex is asking procurement to start paperwork. If the outage window exceeds 90 minutes of token degradation we should consider escalated credit up to $40k. Jonas — need approval path.

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

---

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Naranajan <priya_naranajan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Jul 2028 09:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Prism Health - AZ1 production impact (urgent)

Priya/Marissa — Ops update:
- We can push a routing override now scoped to prism-health-prod at 09:45 PT. Graceful drain estimated ~10–14 minutes.
- us-west3 has spare capacity: we can provision 2x emergency infer nodes (GPUType: A100-80GB) within 6 minutes; warm-up + KV warmfill ~8 minutes.
- Recommendation: start with 30% traffic shift immediately and monitor tail latency; if stable after 8 minutes shift the remainder. This reduces risk of cascade.

I’ll put the runbook actions in the incident channel and tag oncall. We will capture token-level metrics and keep the customer updated every 10 minutes.

Dylan Brooks
SRE Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

---

From: Priya Naranajan <priya_naranajan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@prismhealth.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@prismhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@prismhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Jul 2028 09:50:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Production errors and latency spike from AZ1 - emergency plan + credit timeline

Alex / Samantha — quick update and immediate plan:
1) We will initiate a scoped regional steer for prism-health-prod at 09:45 PT. The steer will be staged: 30% -> 100% in 8–12 minutes if metrics are stable.
2) Ops will provision emergency nodes in us-west3 and warm the KV cache to reduce cold misses.
3) We will keep a 10-minute cadence on the bridge and share token latency and 5xx dashboards.

Credit request: please complete the attached SLA credit request form (procurement note) and we’ll route to our finance ops for approval. For transparency — if the degradation window exceeds 90 minutes we will escalate to an executive approval path for a one-off credit.

Attachments: sla_credit_request_form.pdf (attachment)

I will update you at 10:05 PT with the first shift metrics.

—
Priya Naranajan
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
priya_naranajan@redwood.ai

---

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priya Naranajan <priya_naranajan@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Jul 2028 13:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Exec approval for one-time credit (Prism Health outage)

Marissa/Priya — I reviewed the incident timeline and customer impact. Given this was a regional infrastructure contention that caused an extended production degradation for a high-tier customer, I approve up to $35,000 USD one-time credit to be issued to Prism Health, contingent on: 1) incident postmortem within 72 hours, 2) ops remediation plan to avoid similar KV/cache thrash, and 3) a short RCA readout with Prism engineering in 48 hours.

Please prepare the credit memos and route to finance for issuance. Dylan — please include the remediation milestones in the postmortem and set SLO guardrails.

Jonas Weber
VP, Customer Reliability & Partnerships
Redwood Inference
